notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The CivicPlus Elections page has an 'Election Results' tab ('We will have links here when we have the information to post.') listing per election unofficial totals, early totals, reconciliation forms and canvass files. Each unofficial file opened is a scanned Electionware 'Summary Results Report ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' with county totals only: 2024 general (DocumentCenter 389, 'TX Panola County 241105 General 6110', 'Election Day Precincts Reporting 19 of 19', footer read as 'Election Summary - 11/05/2024 9:1x PM', scan created Nov 6 03:10 UTC = 9:10 PM CST); 2026 primary ('March 3rd Unofficial Totals', DocumentCenter 1288, footer 'Election Summary - 03/03/2026 9:13 PM', scan created 9:21 PM CST); 2026 runoff ('Unofficial Results', DocumentCenter 1753, footer read as 'Election Summary - 05/26/2026 8:01 PM', scan created 8:37 PM CDT). No precinct-level report is listed for any of them apart from the canvass files ('Rep Canvass', 'Dem Canvass', not opened). The server stamps every response, PDFs included, with the request time as Last-Modified (e.g. Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:39:29 GMT), so there is no upload-time evidence; confidence is therefore low. DocumentCenter 388 and 390 are May 2024 and March 2024 results (not target elections). Footer times read from 45 dpi renders. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-2): 2024_general LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2024-11-05 21:10 CT; 2026_primary LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-03-03 21:13 CT; 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 20:37 CT.
tag_rationale: Results: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff LATER. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so the rule gives COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. (Recomputed under Rule 43, 2026-10-02.)
